comment: If you work hard, participate, and do the assigned work well, News, Media, and Society is an awesome course to take. He mixes up his teaching style so it's not just a lecture everyday, and he assigns mostly interesting readings.  His office hours were incredibly useful, and he's a very respectable professor.

SN is very intimidating during the first weeks. He calls upon you in class when you aren't ready. And if you don't have a good response, he will pressure you into a good answer with phrases like "Think again" and "you need a better answer". But that is why we love him. There is a lot of work for this class, but he is not an unreasonable grader.
put me to sleep, i spent forever on his project and got a C, took class as elective but he treats it as if it's the only class you take for the semester, he needs to loosen up the classroom
I got C- and I still absolutely like him... imagine how good he has to be. I forgive him for destroying my GPA :)

I hated Nash!  I can't beleive that people really like him.  I got a C- in his class, my lowest grade ever.  He acts like he enjoys his students, however, if someone doesn't agree with him, that person is toast.
Nash knows what he's talking about. He's a hard grader, and expects very clean work. Anything remotely sub-par will be graded as such, so expect to work for this class.
hard but its a requirement for the major!

The man knows exactly what he is talking about. The readings he assigns take much time and effort but his lectures and activities in class are extremely interesting. He also will help outside of class and loves getting to know his students. Tough classes, but take it to experience his personality.
One of my best profs here at Richmond. Intelligent (but modest enough), relates well to the students, good sense of humor, and makes class extremely interesting.
He is extremely intelligent and a really great teacher.
You will work hard, but it's worth it. He really makes you think.
